tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Render a public web page in Chromium and return a screenshot. Use fullPage for the whole scrollable page; very tall pages come back as a link instead of an inline image, and a fullPage WebP capture of a page taller than 16383px is clipped to that height (reported as fullPageClip) — use jpeg or png f

tools.name: get_quota
tools.description: With no API key, reports today's anonymous MCP screenshot allowance per IP (with a shared per-network ceiling when applicable). With an API key, reports the organisation's monthly credits pooled across its API keys. The public GET /v1/screenshot quota is separate; this check consumes no capture allo
